title: Euterpe agent: config.yaml
description: How the agent interacts: note or audio input, grid (clock) or event mode, and the clock.

title.description: The system's name, shown on the start screen.

noteMode.description: The user plays notes (laptop keyboard, MIDI keyboard, on-screen keyboard).

audioMode.description: The agent gets the microphone: processAudioBuffer is called for every frame.

audioOut.description: The agent plays audio it generates: ctx.audioOut.write(), the renderAudio hook, or {audio} in a hook's return value.

status.description: processNoteEvent is called for every user note, as it happens.
processClockEvent is called on every clock tick.

eventBuffer.description: The clock event carries userNotes: every user note since the last tick.

quantizedEvents.description: The clock event carries userQuantizedNotes: the user's notes on this tick, aligned to the grid.

input.description: At most this many simultaneous user notes in userQuantizedNotes.

delayedExecution.description: Run the agent a quarter tick after the tick, to catch notes played slightly late (better score alignment).

windowSize.description: Samples per frame passed to processAudioBuffer (at audioModeSettings.sampleRate). Default 1024.

hopSize.description: Samples between consecutive frames: at most windowSize; default windowSize (no overlap).

sampleRate.description: The agent's input sample rate: frames are resampled to it (e.g. 16000 for a speech-rate model). Default: the page's (44100 or 48000, set by the device).

echoCancellation.description: The browser's echo cancellation on the microphone. Default false (it distorts music).

noiseSuppression.description: The browser's noise suppression. Default false (it removes sustained tones).

autoGainControl.description: The browser's automatic gain control. Default false (it pumps the level).

channels.description: 1: mono (played on both speakers), 2: stereo. Default 2.

latency.description: Seconds of audio kept queued ahead of playback (renderAudio fills up to this). More: fewer dropouts, later sound. Default 0.1.

sampleRate.description: The agent's output sample rate: renderAudio / ctx.audioOut.write take audio at this rate and Euterpe resamples it. Default: the page's.

blockSize.description: renderAudio is always asked for exactly this many frames (for models with a fixed block size). Default: variable, in steps of 128.

autoStart.description: Start the clock when the user presses the start button.

clockPeriod.description: A fixed tick period in ms (free time); null to use BPM and ticksPerBeat.

introModal.description: Show agent/intro.md when the page opens.
